label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter flows through param -> scrub (via regex replaceAll) -> response.getWriter(). The regex '(?i)<script' only removes <script tag starts, allowing XSS via event handlers (onclick/onerror), javascript: URLs, or other payloads that don't begin with <script. Resolved sink value: scrub = param.replaceAll("(?i)<script", "") which retains attacker-controlled data capable of executing scripts in browser.

evidence.note: User input param flows to scrub via insufficient regex sanitization, then printed to response writer
